profile.headline: Sr Software Developer at S&S HealthCare Strategies [Cinn]
profile.summary: IT professional with 20 years of experience in full software development lifecycle.  Strengths include broad knowledge base, creativity, dedication and vision. Able to rapidly learn new technologies and apply them to successful business solutions.

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description: Creating Reports using MS SQL and BI, ETL using SQL and Python tools to exchange medical data with Pharmaceutical Benefits Management systems.

positions.title: Senior Application Developer
positions.description:
Applied object oriented analysis and design techniques to create an application for patient medication regiment review which allowed entry and transmission of drugs, lab results, diagnosis and create multiple reports. Also created multiple support applications for transmission of data, file transfer, report status, encrypt data, decrypt data and de-identify patient protected healthcare information for HIPAA compliance. 
•	Used SQL Server Reporting Services reports and subscriptions to present reports on the Internet via ASP web pages. Designed procedures to aggregate data from more than 20 million patients using grouping, rollups and table partitioning. Reduced aggregated procedure execution time by 60% using explain plans and Oracle SQL tuning techniques.
•	Used Oracle procedures to create XML and call TIBCO web services using database packages to request lists of drugs and diagnosis. Created procedures for TIBCO to insert requested data into Oracle. Designed and built object oriented application interface to download this data, edit it and upload it back to the server.
•	Designed architecture, user interfaces, coded and tested utilities for merging nursing facility data and monitor progress with Oracle stored procedures.
•	Designed architecture, user interface, and wrote standalone application for creation, testing and uploading business rules stored as strings and parsed into a class structure. Provided interface for graphically viewing and manipulating rules as objects and stored the objects locally as XML or uploaded them to server database. 
•	Created Oracle stored procedures using Java based installed packages to send formatted HTML email to corporate executives based on key business events.
•	Created Windows MSI and script based installers using InstallShield for application deployment.

positions.title: Quality Assurance Lead
positions.description:
Developed testing strategies for application used to enter patient assessments and submit them to Medicare and the Veteran’s Administration via MDS 2.0, 3.0, XML and HL7 protocols. 
•	Designed, developed and implemented test automation framework by writing DLL extensions to the Rational Automated Testing tool. Built VBScript interface that non-technical business users could use to enter test cases and user scenarios. Tool interpreted business cases and tested applications writing results in HTML/CSS that could be viewed using a web browser.  Successfully reduced regression test time by 50%.
•	Created test plans, schedules and project plans for 10 member test team. Recorded testing matrices, reported test team results and trained team in heuristic, risk-based and exploratory testing.
•	Trained QA test team in writing VBScript based test scripts for Rational Automated Testing tool.

positions.title: Software Consultant
positions.description:
•	Modified COBOL, RPG, and IBM 3270 Assembly Language programs for Y2K bug. Used TSO, ROSCOE, and FileAID to update and unit test code changes. Submitted batch jobs using MVS JCL.
•	Tested UNIX based applications in networked environment. Data was manually edited in VI Editor and submitted to processes via command line.
•	Wrote test plans, test cases, use cases, user scenarios used to manually execute tests.
•	Executed tests manually, tracked defects and entered bugs/defects/enhancement requests in tracking software. Used both Agile and Waterfall Development Methodologies.

positions.title: QA Analyst
positions.description:
•	Gathered and wrote software requirements, test plans, test procedures and executed tests. Recorded defects and tracked progress in PVCS Tracker.
•	Tested UNIX based applications in networked environment. Data was manually edited in VI Editor and submitted to processes via command line. 
•	Documented test processes and trained testers.
